title: Letter formation & handwriting
examples: Where do I start writing the letter 'a'?
What is the difference between a capital and a small letter?
How do I make the letter 'g' without going outside the lines?

explain.say: Each letter has a place to start. Starting in the right place keeps your writing neat.

items: Each letter has a start point
Then follow the strokes in order

explain.say: Many letters start at the top and go down first. The letter m starts at the top.

draw.text: m: start at the top, go down

explain.say: Some letters have a tall part that goes up high. This is called an ascender. The letter l has one.
Some letters have a tail that goes below the line. This is called a descender. The letter g has one.
Big letters are called capitals. Small letters are called lowercase. A capital A is taller than a small a.

faq.q: Why do I have to know where to start writing letters?
faq.a: Knowing the start point helps your letters look neat. It also makes your writing easier to read.
asks: What is the correct starting point for a letter?
Do I always start at the top when writing?

faq.a: Ascenders are parts of letters that go up high, like the tall line in l. Descenders are parts that go below the line, like the tail of g.
asks: What is a letter that goes below the line?
Can you show me an ascender letter?

faq.q: How do I know when to use a capital letter?
faq.a: You use a capital letter at the start of a sentence. You also use one for the names of people and places.
asks: When is a capital letter needed?
Do I always use a capital at the start?

faq.q: Is the capital letter always bigger than the small letter?
faq.a: Not always. Capitals are tall, but tall lowercase letters like b and l reach the same height.

faq.q: What if my letter is too messy?
faq.a: Try to slow down. Start each letter in its start place, and make the strokes in order.
asks: How to improve my letter formation?

facts: Many lowercase letters start at the top.
Ascenders are parts that rise above the main writing line.
Descenders drop below the main writing line.
Capitals are used for the beginning of sentences and names.

quiz.say: Look at the letter b. Tap where your pen starts.
quiz.why: You start b at the top of its tall line. Then you go down and round.

wrong.0: Starting at the bottom makes the tall line go the wrong way, so start at the top.
wrong.2: The middle is where the round part joins, so start higher up.

quiz.say: Tap the letter with a tail below the line.
quiz.why: The letter g has a tail that goes below the line. This tail is a descender.

wrong.0: The letter a sits on the line and stays small.
wrong.1: The letter l goes up high, so it has an ascender.

quiz.say: Think about writing your name. Which letter is a capital?
quiz.why: A name starts with a capital letter. The other letters are lowercase.

wrong.1: Only the first letter is a capital, and the rest are lowercase.
wrong.2: The capital goes at the start of the name.
